headline: Romania's inflation refuses to fall, reaching 6.9% in October after a short-lived easing over the summer - Forbes.ro
summary: Romania's annual inflation reached 6.9% in October, reversing a short-lived easing over the summer. The reading points to persistent price pressures in the economy.
why: Inflation trends shape central bank policy and government bond yields, which matter to investors in Romanian assets.
